text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, on the way back from shopping with Vivlos—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oyo?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy,
they're up to something!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah!
Incredible, so coool♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey,
won't you try it out for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Who knows,
I might just win a hot spring trip!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Out of everyone in my family,
I was always the best at stuff like this!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't it great?
Right? Right?
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the shopping just now,
I happened to have one lottery ticket in hand.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay♡
All right...——

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, hey, mister.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
M-Me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Hey, so, I have a favor to ask~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *staaaare...* ♡

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Gasp...!?
U-Um, well...
choice_data_list: No amount of begging will win you the grand prize.
No amount of begging will win you the grand prize, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I can't~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“It's fine, though—luck is on my side♡
Alrighty, let's give it a shot!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos enthusiastically
turned the lottery wheel crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oooohhh?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy-poo~~?!
choice_data_list: As expected, you've really got it!
As expected, you've really got it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, isn't this insane?!
She's just too amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
I'm so happy for you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~♡
Maybe it's all thanks to you, big bro?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You said a little prayer for me
so that I'd win, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Just saying a little prayer
isn't cheating, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"If you cheer for me, mister,
I feel like I could do anything♡"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?
Alright, let's go cheer them on in the race too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~.
Thanks~!
choice_data_list: (Still so good at wheedling, as always...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we've got no choice
but to give it our all, right, Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, you need stamina to do your best, right?
So...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
First, we go to a hot spring
and recharge our energy, like♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An important race awaits Vivlos ahead. Under normal circumstances, this would be the time to focus on training, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“...I mean, you have an important race coming up.
It can wait until after.”
choice_data_list: ...Sure.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Go enjoy the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure?
Even though you have a race?"
choice_data_list: You've been through a lot, after all.
You've been through a lot, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Emotionally, there had been a nonstop series of tense moments.
Vivlos has been working so hard, and more than anything,
I've been wanting to give her the praise she deserves.
choice_data_list: This must be your reward for working so hard!
This is your reward for all that hard work!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: A reward...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: I'll adjust my schedule, when would be good for you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...At the very end of
everything we have planned!"
choice_data_list: Huh? Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine.
I'd really rather wait until everything is over!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If it's a reward for working hard,
I already got one from Trainie.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You give me lots of praise every single day, right?
That's all I need!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"So why don't we make the hot springs trip
a reward for me... and you, Trainy?"
choice_data_list: Mine...?
Mine...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You've been working super hard too, Trainie.
I want you to get a real reward!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna work super hard again starting tomorrow...
So let's look forward to our reward, Trainie!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling Vivlos's thoughtfulness...
I quietly slipped the hot springs trip ticket into
the last page of my planner.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, isn't that amazing!?
Am I not totally blessed~!?"
choice_data_list: That's incredible!
Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right, right? ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, that hamburg steak
looks crazy delicious! ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
I'll contact you later~
choice_data_list: Contact?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
'Cause it looks super duper tasty!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want the people I love
to taste it too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Big Sis?
Can you come to the cafeteria right now~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!
It's so yummy, Big Sis♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true... It's well-seasoned,
but you can still taste the natural savoriness of the meat.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right? Sis, you're way too good at food reviews!
As expected of my big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainy, you too!
Give us your food review!
choice_data_list: …So juicy! So full of flavor!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyah.
Sounds like a pun~!
choice_data_list: (Even after I put so much thought into it...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, this is fun.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It would've been even more perfect
if Cheva-chi was here too, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I handed Cheval's share
to her roommate.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thanks.
It really was pretty sudden, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It smells so good~,
I'm sure Cheval-chi will gobble it right up too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If everyone thinks it's tasty,
then I'm super duper happy too! ♡

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa!
There's so much!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay for me to take this much?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course!
Eat up and enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Thank you♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Train-chi!
We have this whole bunch, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna do this—
let's make it a party!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, this!
The carrot cake I made!”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, wow!
They're bite-sized and so cuteâª

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you add some unusual spices?
It has such a stylish finish. Was it your idea?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, going for a little Dubai vibe~ ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: A spice souk... Inspired by an open-air market, I mixed together all kinds of spices♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Sis and Trainy did
most of the cooking, though♡
choice_data_list: Haha...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: What did everyone make with carrots for today~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the garden party proceeded in grand fashion.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aw, third prize, huh?
choice_data_list: Still, a win is a win.
Still, a win is a win.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~... But still, I really wanted to win something amazing.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy,
comfort me~...
choice_data_list: ...I—I did my best!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: Great job turning it with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: ...If you draw, every ticket will be first prize!
...If you draw, every ticket will be first prize!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Oh, Trai-ner, come on now~~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Giggle... Ehehe,
ah well, anything goes~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Mister!
Please give me the first-prize carrot!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't quite sure what was going on,
but Vivlos happily accepted
the single carrot.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"No waaaay!
Whyyy!?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of all things...
A consolation prize!?
choice_data_list: Stuff like this is just down to luck...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still,
a truly blessed celebrity would win, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then that means I'm not a celebrity at all!
No waaaay~~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, Viwlos's mood
had taken a total downturn..."
